help_text:
owa-graph calendar - List/create events, find meeting times, RSVP

Shortcuts:
  events     List events (or calendarView with --from/--to)
  create     Create event (--subject, --start, --end, [--attendees], [--body], [--tz])
  update     Update --id event (--subject, --body)
  delete     Delete --id event
  findtimes  Find meeting times (--attendees [--duration])
  accept     Accept --id [--comment]
  decline    Decline --id [--comment]

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
